observations.behavior: Replaces a fixed 15-day retention fallback with a conditional check against a table column `retention_days` before falling back to the header-based 15-day value.
observations.code_quote: observed_timestamp + toIntervalDay(if((retention_days IS NOT NULL) AND (retention_days > 0), retention_days, toInt32OrDefault(_headers.value[indexOf(_headers.name, 'retention-days')], toInt32(15)))) AS original_expiry_timestamp,
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse-backed retention configuration to override the default 15-day expiry, potentially reducing unnecessary data retention and storage costs. This could help PostHog users who configure warehouse-specific retention policies, though the exact benefit depends on warehouse setup and is not demonstrated by this hunk alone.
